title: WordPress Development Agency in Miami
metaTitle: WordPress Development Agency in Miami, FL | TDM
metaDescription: Custom WordPress sites for Miami businesses: fast mobile pages, booking and listing integrations, SEO-ready structure, security and maintenance. Free consultation.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) designs, builds and maintains WordPress websites for Miami businesses. We write custom themes, rebuild slow or hacked sites, and set up the editing screens so your own staff can update pages without a developer. For a Miami company the site usually has to do two extra jobs: connect cleanly to the booking, listing or ordering systems the business runs on, and load fast on the phone of someone deciding where to go in the next ten minutes.

sections.heading: What a Miami website has to handle
paragraphs: Many visits to a Miami business site come from a phone, often from someone on the move: a visitor in South Beach choosing a restaurant, a homeowner in Kendall looking for an AC repair company, a buyer in another state browsing condos late at night. Heavy themes, oversized images and stacked plugins make those visitors wait, and they leave. We build for speed on mobile connections from the first day.

Many Miami sites also depend on connections to other systems. A broker's site pulls listings from the MLS. A restaurant in Little Havana links to its reservation and ordering providers. A clinic in Coral Gables takes appointment requests and must treat patient details with care. A charter company in Coconut Grove needs live availability. WordPress can do all of this, but the quality of those integrations decides whether the site is quick and stable or slow and fragile.

Florida businesses have also faced a large number of claims that their websites are not usable by people with disabilities. We build with accessibility in mind: readable contrast, keyboard navigation, text alternatives for images and properly labelled forms. That is good practice for every visitor and lowers a real risk.

sections.heading: What our WordPress work includes
paragraphs: Each project runs through discovery, design, build and launch, followed by support. You see the design before it is built and a working version on a staging address before it goes live.
bullets: Custom themes that carry only the code your site needs, not a pre-made theme loaded with unused features.
Service and location pages for the districts you serve, each with its own editable content.
SEO built in: clean URLs, structured data, optimised images and strong mobile speed.
Migration of existing content with redirects, so current rankings are protected during a rebuild.
Security hardening, updates, backups and ongoing maintenance.
A handover session so your team can edit pages and publish posts.

sections.heading: Fix, rebuild or start again
paragraphs: A lot of the WordPress work we are asked about in Miami is not a new site. It is a site built years ago on a bought theme, weighed down by plugins, that has become slow or has been hacked. We audit it first. Sometimes cleaning up, updating and hardening the existing build is enough. Sometimes a rebuild on a custom theme costs less over the next few years than keeping the old one alive. We tell you which, with reasons.

presence: A member of our team is based in Miami. Design and development are done remotely by the wider TDM team, with review calls at each stage and a staging site you can test yourself.

faqs.q: Can you connect a WordPress site to the MLS or a booking system?
faqs.a: Yes. We connect WordPress to listing feeds, reservation and ordering providers, appointment tools and CRMs. What is possible depends on what each provider allows, so we check that before design starts and build the integration so it does not slow the site down.

faqs.q: How much does a WordPress website cost in Miami?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of page types, integrations and whether the site sells online. We give a quote after a free consultation, once the scope is clear.

faqs.q: How long does it take to build a WordPress site?
faqs.a: That depends on your requirements, the content to be prepared and the integrations involved. The timeline is agreed in the project plan after discovery.

faqs.q: My Miami business site was hacked. Can you fix it?
faqs.a: Usually, yes. We clean the site, find how the attacker got in, update and harden it, and set up backups and monitoring. If the build is too old or damaged to trust, we recommend a rebuild and explain why.

faqs.q: Will you maintain the site after launch?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer ongoing maintenance covering updates, security, backups and small changes. You own the site and can move it elsewhere at any time.
